title: HNBGU Notification 2026 - Apply for Various Project Assistant Posts
description: The Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (HNBGU) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of various Project Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in M.Sc. or M.Pharm can use this chance and apply for the HNBGU Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
